question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**build**" means to develop or form something, typically something positive like trust or relationships. (निर्माण करना)
 
• In this context, "building trust" means creating a bond of reliability and confidence with colleagues and supervisors.
 
• The other options: "**select**," "**demolish**," and "**depth**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Behaving appropriately and professionally can help **build**__ trust with your colleagues and supervisors. When you demonstrate that you are reliable and can be trusted, your colleagues are more likely to support you and help you succeed.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Select (चयन करना)**: means to choose from a number of alternatives. It is not suitable in this context.
 
• **Demolish (ध्वस्त करना)**: means to destroy or ruin something. It is not appropriate here.
 
• **Depth (गहराई)**: refers to the distance from the top or surface to the bottom. It is not appropriate here.
